text:
I had Invisalign treatment here and I really admire the doctor. He explained everything well and paid attention to detail. He even made the trays until my teeth were in place.

Unfortunately, when I bought the course, I bought the lump sum payment because I wanted a promotional price. The staff member was very polite and told me it was a fixed price for everything, with no additional fees. But in the end, they still charged me extra, including the minor things like the rubber bands and shipping.

Even more recently, the staff member has been saying that they haven't charged me for the braces (even though they should have, since we paid the lump sum).

Overall, it's okay, but if you're going to buy the Invisalign course, paying in installments might be better.
